name: iit-DLSLab/Quadruped-PyMPC

name: iit-DLSLab/gym-quadruped
description: Mujoco Gym environment for the control of quadruped robots

name: iit-DLSLab/morphosymm-rsl-rl
description: Extension of RSL-RL for using Morphological Symmetries in IsaacLab
